title: Orthodontic Benefit Summary for the Prepaid Dental HMO Plans
content:
Comprehensive orthodontics under the Prepaid Dental HMO Plans is a fixed member copay, set by plan and by the patient's age at banding, covering a stated number of months of active treatment, with a separate copay for retention.

## The amounts and what each covers

- **Child orthodontic copay**: USD member copay for comprehensive orthodontics for a patient under the child age limit at banding, covering the stated months of treatment.
- **Adult orthodontic copay**: USD member copay for comprehensive adult orthodontics.
- **Retention copay**: USD copay for retention (retainers and retention visits) after active treatment.
- **Months of active treatment**: months of active treatment covered by the orthodontic copay; each month beyond is at the orthodontist's monthly fee.
- **Child age limit**: age in years; the child orthodontic copay applies when banding occurs before this birthday.

| Plan | Child copay | Adult copay | Retention copay | Months of active treatment covered | Child age limit (banding before this birthday) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 | 2195.00 | 2595.00 | 295.00 | 24 | 19 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 315 | 1995.00 | 2395.00 | 275.00 | 24 | 19 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 415 | 1895.00 | 2295.00 | 250.00 | 24 | 19 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 515 | 1795.00 | 2195.00 | 225.00 | 24 | 19 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 615 | 1695.00 | 2095.00 | 200.00 | 24 | 19 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 715 | 1495.00 | 1895.00 | 175.00 | 24 | 19 |

## Which copay applies: the banding date against the 19th birthday

Every plan sets the child age limit at 19 years and the covered active treatment at 24 months.

| Banding date (hypothetical patient) | Before the 19th birthday? | Copay that applies |
|---|---|---|
| The day before the 19th birthday | Yes | Child orthodontic copay |
| On the 19th birthday | No | Adult orthodontic copay |
| Any date after the 19th birthday | No | Adult orthodontic copay |

## Months beyond the covered treatment

The orthodontic copay covers 24 months of active treatment. Each month of active treatment beyond the 24th is at the orthodontist's monthly fee. Hypothetical example: active treatment that runs 27 months has 3 months beyond the covered 24, each at the orthodontist's monthly fee.

## Points of reference

- The retention copay is a separate amount for retainers and retention visits after active treatment and is not part of the child or adult copay.
- Hypothetical example: a patient on the Cascade DentalCare DHMO 715 banded at age 16 has the child copay of 1495.00 for the 24 months of active treatment and the retention copay of 175.00 for retention.
